items.title: Senior Housing Demand Is Rising. Can These 4 REITs Turn It Into Bigger Dividends?
items.summary: Baby boomers are turning 80 while builders put up almost no new senior housing, a setup that pushes rents and occupancy higher. But operator costs and government reimbursement decide how much profit actually reaches shareholders, and these four REITs handle that risk very differently.

items.title: Is Ventas (VTR) Undervalued On Strong Q3 Results And Higher Full Year Guidance?
items.summary: Ventas (VTR) is back in focus after third quarter results topped earnings expectations, supported by higher funds from operations and stronger contributions from senior housing and outpatient medical properties. Despite the earnings beat and higher full year guidance, Ventas shares have slipped over the past quarter, with a 90 day share price return down 14.7% and a softer 7 day move.
